description: This Java source file defines the SnapshotStreamingActor class, an Akka actor responsible for streaming snapshot data from a MongoDB-based persistence store in a service. It handles streaming commands, manages actor lifecycle, and interacts with MongoDB through a read journal. The class includes methods for creating Props, starting the streaming process, and mapping database snapshots to domain objects.

classes.name: SnapshotStreamingActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that streams snapshots from MongoDB storage upon request. Implements messaging handling, initialization, and shutdown logic necessary for streaming snapshot data asynchronously.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates an Akka Props configuration for the SnapshotStreamingActor with specified mapping functions. Used for standard actor creation.

methods.name: propsForTest
methods.description: Creates an Akka Props configuration with a mocked MongoDB connection and read journal, primarily for unit testing purposes.

methods.name: createSource
methods.description: Generates an Akka Source stream of snapshots based on the provided SudoStreamSnapshots command.

methods.name: mapSnapshot
methods.description: Converts a BSON Document from MongoDB into a StreamedSnapshot object used for streaming.

methods.name: startStreaming
methods.description: Initiates the streaming process and sends a SourceRef object back to the requester.
